newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanshin Construction defaults on debts.
newsitem.headline: Hanshin Construction defaults on debts.

text.p: South Korea's leading Hanshin Construction Co formally defaulted on debts on Monday as it failed to honour 2.6 billion won worth of debts, major creditor SEOULBANK said.
A SEOULBANK official said the nation's 24th largest construction company first defaulted on 21.8 billion won in debt obligations on Saturday.
Hanshin sought court receivership from its creditors on last Friday after determining it would be unable to pay its debts.
SEOULBANK earlier said the bank would provide no additional credits to Hanshin because it believed the company's financial condition would worsen.
The Korea Stock Exchange resumed trading in Hanshin Construction on Monday after placing the stocks under supervision. It closed at 3,020, down 260 won.
